description: Behavioral contract of the write-for-humans skill: reads the shared writing guidance, establishes the reader's task and starting knowledge, leads with the result, names the actor the source gives unless the actor is the reader, keeps a necessary exception and a stated uncertainty through editing, invents no approver and attributes a claim about another source to the source that makes it, identifies an unsupported consequential claim instead of calling the artifact ready, reports a missing dependency by path while delivering independent work, delivers reply-as-artifact prose without preface or recap, keeps a narrow edit narrow, and closes a saved artifact with a delivery receipt and nothing else.
